backup.production_rule: Move stock to another item (D-383, spec docs/s122/SPEC-stock-transfer.md incl. Revision 1). Adds the closed table inventory_item_moves (RLS on, revoke all, no API grant), inventory_usage_intervals.moved_between (numeric not null default 0), inventory_usage.moved_from_item_id (uuid null, references inventory_items) and inventory_usage.moved_at. Four security definer functions (empty search_path, execute for authenticated only): move_inventory_stock_v1, move_inventory_usage_v1, undo_inventory_move_v1, get_inventory_item_moves_v1; two internal helpers with no grants. Patches four live bodies in place with md5 guards (CR stripped, 55000 on a body that is neither the expected original nor already patched): record_inventory_anchor_v1 (original a8c9099d20a49fa57f266e0c2a73c3eb, patched f38dcf164dad76b9cda818509400a633); record_missed_refill_v1 (original d0d9cf73fea6e67150d0766bdede7d02, patched eb75c59afba9ac1984fb4b774554b503); record_inventory_usage (original c1c7bff8e55b4aab5528b9fc60a49740, patched 365f7c6d50258a611612465e4ad3624b); record_restock_v1 (original 490f7db83c6cf1f1dfef72452a4f49e7, patched 94a9e42b7b2a439852be3c9ae591010d). record_inventory_anchor_v1 and record_missed_refill_v1 count moved_between as a flow (consumed = prev + received + moved - now); record_inventory_usage and record_restock_v1 find a [key:] replay row under the item it was moved from. A move is never a count or an anchor. Stock moves write numeric audit rows so inventory_qty_at_v1 stays exact; usage moves write usage_moved rows with shelf_before and shelf_after only.
backup.notes: The restore point was taken 2026-11-19T06:13Z for the rehearsal; restamp it with a new backup at apply time (the checker refuses one older than an hour). Apply AFTER every s120 release (stops with 55000 when a patched body is not as expected). Roll the admin app back before the SQL.

rollback.safe_until: Always, with data loss by design: every recorded move and undo and the moved_between of every interval are dropped. Shelves stay where the moves put them, usage rows stay under the item they were re-pointed to, and consumed / accepted of closed intervals are not touched.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261122_s122_item_moves.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh; the four bodies must be back to md5 a8c9099d20a49fa57f266e0c2a73c3eb, d0d9cf73fea6e67150d0766bdede7d02, c1c7bff8e55b4aab5528b9fc60a49740, 490f7db83c6cf1f1dfef72452a4f49e7 and the four move functions must be null. Roll the admin app back first.

feature_flags.name: no_flag_the_app_follows_the_sql
feature_flags.required_state: None. Old app builds keep working: nothing existing changes shape; the four move functions are new and unused until the admin app ships.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour, or restore_point / verified_at are still the placeholders
an s120 release is not applied first (the migration stops with 55000 when a patched body is not as expected)
the live md5 of record_inventory_anchor_v1, record_missed_refill_v1, record_inventory_usage or record_restock_v1 is neither the expected original nor the patched one
the rehearsal has not run the migration and s122_item_moves.sql green on this commit, compatibility.verified is still false
